recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Revisit only if the work group wants a materially different rendering or conformance rule for group/display behavior, not merely a more explicit section title.
issue_request: FHIR-17439 was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to clarify the difference between Questionnaire item types group and display; the approved resolution rejected moving usage material into Scope and Usage but required Notes guidance about when each item type should be used and why.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 14772, imported as git commit b8c5990ac5ad735ba1e8e836fd8a4c6fd3534a3e. That commit subject lists 17439 and adds Questionnaire notes stating that group text is a short label or heading for nested items, while detailed instructions should be represented with display items. The Jira comment also records SVN #14772.
additional_context: The active current source still distinguishes display, group, and question items in source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml and contains the same guidance about group labels versus display instructions. source/fhir.ini has an active questionnaire=Questionnaire resource entry, confirming build scope. The linked 2018 Zulip thread supports the distinction, and later Published issue FHIR-17910 reinforces it through Questionnaire.item.text guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-source notes and item.text comment already convey the approved clarification, and adding a new heading or duplicating the guidance would not materially improve conformance or implementer understanding.
